Container.Name: Plausible Analytics
Container.Overview:
Plausible Analytics is a lightweight, open-source, privacy-friendly alternative to Google Analytics.
IMPORTANT FIRST-START INSTRUCTIONS:
On the first container start paste the following string into Post Arguments to initialize all DBs:
sh -c "sleep 10 && /entrypoint.sh db migrate && /entrypoint.sh db init-admin && /entrypoint.sh start"
Remove it after the first initialization.
DISABLE_REGISTRATION set to "true" after the admin user has registered.
Container.DonateText: Find my work useful? Donations are appreciated!

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY_BASE
Config.Description: Use the following command in terminal to generate: openssl rand -base64 48

Config.Name: TOTP_VAULT_KEY
Config.Description: Use the following command in terminal to generate: openssl rand -base64 32
